name: LOW HOLE
description: Low Hole is an action-packed 'dealer's choice' Poker variant played as Seven Card Stud. Its defining characteristic is the 'Low Hole' wild card rule: the lowest-valued card in each player's individual 'hole' (face-down cards) is wild for that specific player. Because your wild card can change as you receive new hole cards, it creates high-variance gameplay and massive winning hands.

content.text: Low Hole is an action-packed 'dealer's choice' Poker variant played as Seven Card Stud. Its defining characteristic is the 'Low Hole' wild card rule: the lowest-valued card in each player's individual 'hole' (face-down cards) is wild for that specific player. Because your wild card can change as you receive new hole cards, it creates high-variance gameplay and massive winning hands.
Developed in American home poker games as a variant of Seven Card Stud to increase pot sizes and the frequency of big hands (Quads/Straight Flushes).
Standard 52 cards. Ace is high (Ranking: A, K, Q... 2). For the purpose of the 'Low' calculation, 2 is the lowest card.

items.text: Hi-Lo Low Hole: Split pot between best high and best low hands.
Midnight Low Hole: The lowest card in the ENTIRE 7-card hand is wild (Dangerous!).
Low Hole and the Lady: Lowest hole card AND all Queens are wild.
